capabilities.description: Retrieve and reconcile version-relevant HarmonyOS, ArkTS, and ArkUI documentation for a declared SDK and API baseline, preserving document identifiers, locations, retrieval context, and conflicts while treating bundled Skill indexes as discovery aids rather than independent authority.
permissions: Requires authorization to read the declared project context and retain sanitized documentation-query evidence
Requires separately authorized access when a required primary source is unavailable through the local devecocli documentation catalog

capabilities.description: Design and review Stage-model application structure and HAP, HAR, HSP, and App Pack boundaries against declared lifecycle, context, process, thread, delivery, reuse, and publication requirements without inventing project topology or release policy.
permissions: Requires task-scoped authorization to inspect and, when implementation is requested, modify the declared Stage configuration, modules, dependencies, and evidence artifacts
Requires authorization to execute the verified project build matrix; topology exceptions, dependency changes, signing, publication, and release decisions require separate approval

capabilities.description: Implement, review, and repair scoped ArkTS sources for the declared language and SDK baseline, preserving project conventions and distinguishing lint diagnostics, compilation, packaging, runtime behavior, and compatibility evidence.
permissions: Requires task-scoped authorization to read and modify only the declared ArkTS, configuration, test, and evidence surfaces

Requires authorization to run lint and build procedures in the declared environment; dependency installation, configuration weakening, signing, deployment, and production access require separate approval

capabilities.description: Design, implement, repair, and verify scoped ArkUI components and interactions against declared state, navigation, layout, lifecycle, target-device, and accessibility requirements, with API signatures and observed behavior evidenced separately from build success.
permissions: Requires task-scoped authorization to inspect and modify the declared ArkUI, ArkTS, configuration, test, and evidence surfaces while preserving business logic and the existing state-management and navigation paradigms unless their change is explicitly requested

Requires authorization for the named emulator or physical device and interaction scenarios; accessibility acceptance, protected-data handling, signing, distribution, and release require separate authority

capabilities.description: Plan and execute dependency-ordered ArkUI state-management V1-to-V2 migration batches by mapping ownership, initialization, observation, parent-child flow, storage, rendering, reuse, and animation behavior rather than mechanically replacing decorators.
permissions: Requires explicit authorization for the declared migration scope, batch boundaries, source and target baseline, mixed-mode boundary, test changes, and per-batch rollback procedure

Requires authorization to execute compatibility, lint, build, and device scenarios; global substitutions, unsupported baseline changes, dependency changes, and release actions require separate approval

capabilities.description: Inventory and disposition deprecated or compatibility-sensitive HarmonyOS interfaces against explicit source and target SDK/API identifiers, linking each finding to authoritative replacement evidence, behavioral impact, remediation, and post-change verification.
permissions: Requires authorization to inspect the declared source scope and supported-version matrix and, when remediation is requested, modify only the approved interfaces and evidence artifacts

Requires authorization to execute compatibility, lint, and build checks; supported-target removal, compatibility-policy changes, dependency changes, undocumented substitutions, and release decisions require separate approval

capabilities.description: Collect reproducible, target-bound HarmonyOS lint, compatibility, build, package, launch, UI, and runtime-log evidence while keeping each evidence class distinct. Run project-defined tests, coverage checks, or self-inspection only when the project overlay supplies their executable commands and acceptance criteria; otherwise record them as an explicit handoff or exclusion.
permissions: Requires authorization to execute only the declared checks, builds, launch actions, UI interactions, and log collection on named non-production environments and devices using sanitized test data

Project-defined test, coverage, and self-inspection evidence depends on overlay-supplied executable commands, environments, and acceptance criteria; when any are absent they are excluded from execution and handed off explicitly

Requires task-scoped authorization for source or test remediation and for executing overlay-supplied project checks; dependency installation, signing-material access, device reconfiguration, production access, publication, rollout, rollback execution, and release acceptance require separate approval
